title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey everybody!
Thanks for coming to our anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You guys really made some noise for Rin's half... But don't tell me you're tired already!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha, sounds like you're more than ready to go! Great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That means it's time to start my half of the show!
Let's go all out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'll kick things off with my medley!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, guys!!!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was awesome, Len! Great job♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You put on a cool performance. We enjoyed it just as much as the audience.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe, right? Thanks for listening!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that your medley is over... Should we jump into the special segment we thought up?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I finally get to find out what we're doing for this segment!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: None of you would tell me or Rin about it, so we've been wondering.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well? What is it? What are we gonna do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, the segment we've devised is... “A Heart-Stopping Challenge for Rin and Len: The Telepathy Game!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The Telepathy Game?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. The rules are simple.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In a moment, we'll have Len answer some simple questions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Rin will be tasked with guessing how he'll respond.
We'll be asking three questions, so try to guess all of his responses correctly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Gotcha... That means the main thing is whether Rin and I can stay on the same wavelength!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If that's the deal, just you watch! We'll show you how we do teamwork!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, we want to see your best!
Well, without further ado, here's our first question!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Len, what do you want to eat most right now?”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What I want to eat?
Hmm, let me think... Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, you picked already?!
Oh, but I think I know this one...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
My, that was quick.
In that case, say it together in three, two, one...!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Chocolate cake!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow...! They didn't miss a beat!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, we were just talking about wanting some not that long ago! I remember this stuff, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nice, Rin!
I mean... I knew you weren't about to forget anything related to treats.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...! Wait, you're basically saying I'm a glutton!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, let's keep the game going with our second question!
“What animal would you want to be?”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, I've got it...!
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: A bird!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! Right again!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's amazing. They're answering pretty much instantly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then... For the perfect record, here's question three!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “What one thing would you bring to a desert island?”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: To a desert island? Hmm, what would be good...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We haven't talked about anything like that lately...

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Oh! I know!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright Rin, let's do this! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: A mic!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha, I just can't go without singing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Exactly! I thought the same thing♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. The question was my idea... Was it a bit too easy?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: With that, our results are... A perfect game!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, Len, we did it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My heart was racing! That was fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Still, I'm always impressed by you two.
You didn't seem lost for a second on any of the questions, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right? I was good, right? If it's about Len, just ask me♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I should mention though, we were actually quite on the money as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We all thought about how you'd respond when we were writing the questions, and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We all guessed at least one of your answers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I guess we're all paying you close attention.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: C'mon, you're gonna make me blush...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm really happy you guys all know me so well!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for always being by my side!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay... Now that our special segment is over, it's time to celebrate your anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We prepared a message from us to you, so we hope you'll listen♪
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Len!
You've got this power to you that always fills me with cheer♪ It gives me the determination to work just as hard as you do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Keep using that power to bring people more amazing music, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The energy you bring always makes me smile, Len.
Well, sometimes you have so much that you start using it to pull pranks on me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But you always keep it lighthearted and fun. I want to learn from your example, so forgive me when I test out a prank on you, alright?
Again, happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Len.
I was very glad to get confirmation of how well I understand you today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'd like to learn even more, so I'll keep paying you close attention.
What should I focus on figuring out first...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I hope you're having a great anniversary, Len!
Singing with you and chatting with you are both so fun♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's keep singing all kinds of songs together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Len! Happy anniversary!
The two of us are always talking and hanging out together, so don't you think it's weird how we never get bored of it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But... I guess that's 'cause you're you!
You and me, we're together forever!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We all wish you a very happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Plus... Just look! All these people in the audience are just itching to send you good wishes too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're right.
Since we're gathered for the occasion, let's all wish him a happy anniversary together on three! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks, guys!
It makes me so happy hearing that from all of you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Maybe you're here because you've watched me, heard me sing and learned all kinds of stuff about me like Rin and the rest?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe... If so, that'd be great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep singing my absolute hardest for you all, so keep watching and keep listening!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woot woot! That speech was great, Len!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it certainly was.
Well, shall we get back to the show? Everyone seems eager to hear you two sing more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sounds good! Alright... Rin, let's go!
We're gonna keep showing them just how in sync we are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For sure! Let's get everybody fired up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, give it your best, you two!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: We will!
